{{Quote|We are cheered by this victory but deeply disappointed that public servants could fail the Emperor so completely. Be confident that we will not relent until the prisoners have given up the names of their accomplices.|Armand Isard, on the senators' arrests|<ref name="SWI 84" />}}
'''Shea Sadashassa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] from<ref name="SWI 84" /> the peaceful and affluent<ref name="SWI 85">{{InsiderCite|85|Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000}}</ref> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Herdessa/Legends|Herdessa]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]<ref name="SWI 85" /> by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="ArrestsDate">"[[Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241]]" states that Sadashassa was a signatory of the [[Petition of 2000]]. Since the Petition was signed during the events of {{Film|III}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Sadashassa must have been serving in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] by that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] implemented the [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|Sector Governance Decree]], a new system of regional [[Governor/Legends|governorship]] which led to several senators, including Sadashassa, to create the [[Delegation of 2000]] and formally protest his acts with the [[Petition of 2000]] presented in the Senate's last session.<ref name="SWI 84" />

[[Standard day/Legends|Days]] later,<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> after the [[Declaration of a New Order|creation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Sadashassa and sixty-two other members of the Delegation were [[Senatorial arrests/Legends|arrested]] by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]<ref name="SWI 84" /> at the directive of [[Director of Imperial Intelligence|Director]] [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]]<ref name="SWI 85" /> on charges of conspiracy and [[Treason/Legends|treason]] in connection with an alleged [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] insurgency.<ref name="SWI 84" />  Sadashassa had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin. At some point, the senator wore a white [[Jacket/Legends|coat]] with a blue [[shirt]], and wore blue eye shadow.<ref name="SWI 84" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shea Sadashassa first appeared in "[[Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241]]," a segment of the [[in-universe]] [[HoloNet News (Insider)|''HoloNet News'']] department written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], published in the [[Star Wars Insider 84|eighty-fourth]] issue of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]''<ref name="SWI 84" /> on [[September 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SW">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050913.html|text=The Ultimate Clone Guide in ''Star Wars Insider'' #84}}</ref> The issue was illustrated by [[Joe Corroney]], who based Sadashassa's image on his friend [[Roseanna Chickos]], a Boston Rebels FanForce member.<ref name="Blog-joecorroney|22">{{Blog|joecorroney|22|Mr. Hammond, HoloNet News is back online! (sort of&hellip;)}}</ref>
